chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 256: Into the Wujiang Immortal Estate – Mermaid Ambush & Relationship Wisdom
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters the Wujiang Immortal Estate only to face a thousand-strong mermaid Dao-Soldier army. But the real battle is with Nine Lotos over the meaning of friendship and the Dao-heart.
og_title: Into the Wujiang Immortal Estate: Mermaid Army & Relationship Wars
og_description: Ji Ning and crew crash a thousand-strong fish-monster military drill inside the estate. Plus: Nine Lotos ignites a philosophical debate about networking vs. the Dao-heart.
twitter_description: The Wujiang Estate welcomes Ji Ning with a tsunami of angry fish. Nine Lotos hands out brutal social strategy—but Ji Ning’s Dao-heart says no.

lore_anchors.definition: Magical armor inscribed with runes that allows multiple soldiers to fuse their strength into a single, coordinated formation.
The fifth major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s soul transforms into a Primal soul, granting powerful divine sense and the ability to manifest clones.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, meaning “Myriad Manifestations.” The cultivator’s internal energy manifests stars, suns, and moons, vastly accelerating cultivation speed.
The third major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator opens a violet palace within their body, creating an internal dimensional sea for Yuan power.
The innermost, untainted spiritual core of a cultivator, representing their unwavering commitment to their chosen path and principles.
In Chinese social culture, a transactional obligation incurred when someone helps you. Repaying it is expected, but the relationship does not necessarily grow.
A relationship built over time through repeated, genuine interaction, considered more durable than a one-time favor.
A high-ranking hereditary title within the Grand Xia Dynasty, wielding immense political and military authority over a vast territory.
